title: Smoked Chicken Tagine with Morbier Crostini
description: A twist on traditional Italian flavors with the bold taste of Jamaican jerk seasoning and the smokiness of morbier cheese.
instructions: Slice the pre-cooked chicken breasts into thin strips.
In a small bowl, mix together the tagine spice blend and Jamaican jerk seasoning.
Toss the chicken strips in the spice mixture until coated.
Transfer the chicken to a baking sheet and bake for 10-12 minutes, or until lightly browned.
Meanwhile, toast the sliced flatbread in the oven for 5-7 minutes, or until lightly browned.
Top each toasted flatbread slice with a spoonful of the chicken, some crumbled morbier cheese, and a sprinkle of chopped parsley.
Drizzle with zesty lemon juice and serve immediately.
